covers: raylib's lighting example's setup (rlights.h, lighting.vs and lighting.fs, as LoadLightingShader and CreateLight build them in): a plane and a cube lit by point and directional lights, a light turned off; greenman lit and posed twice in a frame (skinned on the GPU, raylib's CPU skinning its oracle), and lit by a program's own shader over <helix/raylib/shaders/skinning.glsl> and lights.glsl
